w: Built in 1909 under German colonial rule and designed by architect Heinrich Bause, the Altes Gefangnis (Old Prison) held Swakopmund's inmates in separate quarters while its grand main building housed prison staff. The gap between an ornate facade and a jail's job makes it one of the town's odder colonial survivors.
s: 1909 German colonial prison with a grand facade
_facts: Main building housed staff; prisoners kept in separate quarters
